aim_origin_without_target.description: A shot fired with no current target aims at the world origin.

air_death_fall_generic_follow_up.description: The falling air death has the generic completion follow-up.

airborne_mutation_hit_raised.description: An airborne infantry unit hit by a warhead of infantry-death kind 9 takes 0, which the defences raise to 1.

alliance_message_slot_colour.description: Alliance messages take the colour of the country's colour field rewritten by the lobby slot.

approach_alternative_walk.description:
A vehicle's approach search tries the eight alternative cells in
the original's order (0, −1), (1, −2), …, (0, 0); off: the eight
neighbours in direction order 0 to 7.

area_damage_per_foundation_cell.description: A building takes one hit for each scanned foundation cell within the spread radius.

barrel_probe_top_left_only.description: An exploding building probes for barrels from its top-left cell only.

berserk_carrier_tote.description: A berserk carrier aircraft can still get tote and its move order; off: it gets no order, like every berserk object.

blackout_one_short.description: A blackout of length d counts as 0 output in at most d − 1 house updates.

build_step_period_cap.description: The step period never exceeds 255 ticks.

building_ammo_fast_rearm.description: A building holding more than 1 round rearms in 1 tick after a shot, over every other kind of delay.

building_cell_attack_no_weapon.description: A building with no weapon in its first slot gets attack over a cell whose generic result is attack (row BC3); off: nothing.

building_fire_point_shift_fixed.description: A building's turret displacement does not turn with its aim.

building_pitch_term.description: A straight shot at a building pitches by the building's art height term.

building_removal_second_round.description:
A building awaiting removal takes a second round of survivors and
smudge steps when it is removed; off: no second round.

building_sight_top_left.description: A building's sight, area reveal and gap field are centred on its top-left foundation cell.

building_smudge_discarded_draws.description: A destroyed building takes up to two ranged draws whose results are not used.

cell_layer_split_on_uneven_deck.description: On a deck over uneven ground, objects come from the deck layer and the record from the ground layer.

cheer_memory_spans_session.description: The last accepted cheer tick carries over between games of a session.

chop_rounding.description: Every floating-point result rounds toward zero (the original's program-wide mode); off: round to nearest, ties to even.

chrono_flash_keeps_order_block.description: A chrono flash restores the order block in force when it started, so a block from game start or an earlier run outlasts it.

cleanup_skips_next_house.description: The unused-house cleanup keeps the house after a removed one.

cliff_back_case_sets.description: Behind a cliff, row 1 of claim 5 becomes rock whatever its land type.

coarse_limit_records_cost.description: A coarse route found at the pending limit still sets the sector's cost.

corridor_free_part_unusable_cells.description: Cells of an unusable category belong to the free part.

corridor_split_probe.description: Whether the progress sector is split is decided at the probe cell.

country_index_wraps.description: Country lists cannot tell apart countries whose indices are equal modulo 32.

cow_idle.description: The hard-coded cow type's idle action can scatter it.

crash_death_weapon_twice.description: An exploding aircraft fires its death weapon at death and again at the crash.

crate_count_humans_only.description: Only human participants count for the initial crate count.

crush_slowdown_counts_self.description: The driving vehicle counts itself as a vehicle in the cell it drives into.

crush_slowdown_first_overlay.description: Ship and walking-vehicle crush slowdown is set by the overlay type of registration index 0.

crush_slowdown_ground_layer.description: The crush slowdown looks at the ground layer whichever layer the vehicle is in.

crush_slowdown_persists.description: The crush-slowdown state ends only when the vehicle next crushes an overlay.

crushable_overlay_stays.description: A crushed crushable overlay that is not a wall stays in its cell.

crusher_entry_ground_layer.description: Row VR2 reads the first vehicle of the ground layer even when the deck layer counts.

crusher_overlay_index0_clear.description: A crusher reads obstacle outcomes as clear in cells whose overlay has registration index 0.

curtain_nullifies_small_detonation.description: A small detonation that finds a curtain-protected object hits only protected objects.

death_weapon_unplaced_projectile.description: The death weapon's projectile tests use its unplaced default position.

deck_side_step_ground_level.description: A step from a bridge deck is judged by the ground level under the deck, so a side step of 1 level lands on ground 3 or 5 levels below; off: such a step onto a cell that is not a bridge cell is refused.

defeat_cancellation_skip.description: Immediate deletions by one destruction hit of a defeat or surrender skip later objects.

defeat_during_end_delay.description: A house defeated during the end delay loses (the person-played house's win turns into a loss and restarts the delay).

defeat_reveal_keeps_pending.description: The defeat reveal leaves the defeated house's pending re-cover marks in place.

defeated_enemy_house_kept.description: A defeated enemy house stays the enemy house until an anger value next changes.

defence_line_partial_factory_check.description: The factory check after a building-factory event covers only the ordinary-building line.

delay_kill_credited_again.description: Every hit that changes the health of a building in a delayed-kill countdown credits its destruction again.

delay_kill_whole_cell_spread.description: The delayed-kill countdown divides by the spread's whole cells, so a spread below one cell gives 0.

deploy_refuses_own_walls.description: A deploying vehicle cannot deploy onto its own house's wall.

detonate_in_planter_name.description: A detonate order is issued in the planter's house's name.

detour_after_tunnel_position.description:
After a tunnel step, the detour pass starts afresh at the cell north
of the tunnel entrance.

detour_mirrored_reference.description:
From the third leg of the detour pass on, the reference distance is
taken to the step's end cell mirrored through the leg's first cell.

disarm_bomb_needs_weapon.description: Disarm bomb gives its attack order only to an actor able to fire; off: it needs only that the actor is movable.

dock_bound_aircraft_ignores_limit.description: A dock-bound aircraft type is tested at queue time by the dock test only.

done_aircraft_click_cancels.description: A left click on a done aircraft with every dock taken cancels it.

double_start_resolution.description: Start positions are resolved twice, from three start lists, the assignment against the early phase's list 2; off: one list after the terrain is loaded.

drive_brake_floor_raises.description: Within the slowdown distance the braking floor raises a slower vehicle to the floor.

drive_curve_chaining_passive_only.description: Only passive vehicles chain two-cell curves.

drive_giveup_ignores_contact.description: A driving vehicle's give-up test at a step check ignores contact.

drive_nearest_from_top_corner.description: The nearest object of the look at a new path's first cell is measured from the cell's top corner; off: from its centre.

drive_subpoint_compounding.description: The step towards the next track point is taken from the current, possibly interpolated, position.

drive_track_end_cap.description: A tick finishes at most one track if it began without one, two if it began on one.

early_phase_stale_country_data.description: The early phase judges passivity by the base rules' country data only; off: by this game's full rules layering.

elevation_deck_cell_level.description: Elevation levels add 4 for every cell marked as carrying a bridge deck.

elite_occupant_skips_occupy_weapon.description: An elite occupant without an elite occupying weapon fires its own primary.

expected_damage_firer_armour.description: The expected damage divides by the armour factor for the firer's kind and the firer's armour multiplier.

experience_cost_victim_house.description: The recipient's actual cost is computed for the destroyed object's house.

failed_packup_keeps_vehicle.description: The vehicle of a failed pack-up remains.

fire_frame_by_stance.description: The fire frame is chosen by stance and weapon, not by the playing kind.

fire_reveal_expires.description: The reveal on fire is a plain reveal that the next re-cover sweep undoes.

first_comment_only.description: Only the type's first idle comment sound is used.

flatten_straight_run_v.description: Some straight runs open a V that flattening replaces.

flatten_threat_start_cell.description: Flattening reads the threat value at the new steps' first cell.

flying_candidates_unfiltered.description: A tracked flying object is not left out for being the source object or a listed harvester.

flying_search_sectors.description: The flying-object search reads only the sectors of F7 and can miss a flying object in range.

follow_index_by_place.description: The placed vehicle numbered i takes the follow value numbered i, not its own entry's; off: each vehicle takes its own entry's value.

forced_start_player_hold.description: A forced start with no switched-on factory starts on a player hold when the house can pay P ÷ 54.

foundation_exit_lists.description: The infantry exit search uses each foundation's fixed exit list, gaps and repeats included.

fraidycat_ammo_panic_ignores_fearless.description: A fraidycat that fires its last round panics even when fearless.

fraidycat_fear_ignores_fearless.description: A fearless fraidycat still gets its fear set by a known attacker.

full_cell_no_regrowth.description: Harvesting a full cell takes it out of growth until a rebuilding.

gap_end_keeps_cover.description: When a hostile gap field stops, its cells stay unexplored until a sight reaches them.

gap_radius_wrap.description: A gap radius is read reduced into −128 … 127.

garrison_range_drops_air_bonus.description: A garrisoned building's range replaces the weapon range and its air bonus.

gate_reverse_snaps.description: A gate door that reverses from closing to opening is at rest open at the gate's next update; off: the reopening takes as long as the closing had run.

gate_tower_fixed_cells.description: A gate's or wall tower's placement and departure recompute the wall bits of fixed cells around its top-left foundation cell only; off: also every wall beside any of its foundation cells.

gattling_air_test_slot_one.description: A gattling type's anti-air test reads the weapon in slot 1.

ground_detonation_misses_aircraft.description: Tracked flying objects are considered only by a detonation above the terrain at the centre of its cell.

height_block_cell.description: The height block tests the displaced cell and the step directions of table T2.

hijack_truce_harvester_check.description: The harvester-truce exception of row I15 never applies.

hover_needs_nonzero_start.description: The hover substitution needs a hover entry starting at a frame other than 0.

hunt_distance_in_leptons.description: The map-wide search measures ground-layer distance in leptons.

hunt_ground_layer_only.description: The map-wide search considers only ground-layer objects besides aircraft.

hunt_ignores_distributed_fire.description: A distributed-fire searcher picks nothing in a map-wide search.

infantry_facing_sector_skew.description: Infantry facing groups are skewed 1024 facing units counter-clockwise.

infantry_fixed_turn_rate.description: Infantry bodies turn at the fixed rate 127.

infantry_limit_exception_exact.description: The infantry in-production exception of the build limit applies only at exactly L owned.

initial_ammo_above_capacity.description:
An explicit initial ammunition above a nonnegative maximum is used as
it stands; off: capped at the maximum.

last_bale_lost.description: The last bale taken from a cell yields nothing.

mind_controlled_passengers_cell_choice.description: Passengers of a mind-controlled open-topped transport take the cell's last object only.

missile_turn_wrap.description: The steering turn step uses only the residue mod 256 and is a signed 16-bit value.

multiple_factory_counts_all.description: Every factory building of the kind counts for the several-factories factor, also those that cannot make the item.

named_deploy_area_fire.description: The deploy area-fire rule singles out one infantry type by name.

narrow_map_partial_pass.description: On a map of width 1 the cell pass visits part of the map.

near_full_health_rounds_up.description: A pre-placed object whose starting health comes out above its strength less 3 starts at full strength; off: it keeps the computed value.

nearby_centre_twice.description: The nearby-cell search examines its centre twice.

negative_level_floor_raised.description: The level base below level 0 is one lepton higher.

negative_self_heal_counts.description: Negative self-heal counts are added without a floor.

nominal_survivor_count.description: A nominal survivor is not added to the infantry count but is taken off when it leaves.

observer_position_handoff.description: An observer's drawn position is handed to the next player needing one.

occupancy_house_side_positions_only.description: The infantry house clears when no side position stays taken.

occupancy_house_stale.description: The infantry house stays that of the last infantry unit to mark, even after it left.

occupancy_override_hides_later_blockers.description: An overriding occupant hides blockers listed after it.

occupant_experience_next_in_turn.description: A garrison's experience goes to the occupant whose turn to fire it is.

occupant_experience_untrained.description: A garrison's firing occupant gains experience whatever its trainable flag.

offmap_cells_shared.description: Every cell that is not legal shares one explored state per house.

omnicrusher_needs_crusher.description: The omni-crusher flag alone makes no vehicle a crusher.

one_sided_building_distance.description: The building reduction applies only to the second object of a distance.

opposite_facing_reversal.description: The close case reverses the occupant's facing by 32767, not 32768.

origin_as_missing_target_point.description: The world origin stands for no target point in both directions.

overlay_list_position_rules.description: Radar overlay colours depend on the overlay type's position in the overlay list.

override_suspends_queued.description: An override suspends the queued behaviour when one is queued.

packup_release_by_guard_spot.description: A packing building releases survivors according to its guard spot and undeploy type only.

packup_sound_on_sale.description: A sold building with a pack-up sound also plays it.

passability_laser_fence_lost.description: Laser-fence sections leave the passability category alone.

passability_wheel_column.description: The passability category judges every class by the wheel column.

passenger_weapon_needs_secondary.description: A passenger weapon index is used only by a firer with weapons in both slots.

path_congestion_toggle.description: Congestion marks follow the parity of each cell's count.

path_no_reopen.description: A recorded search pair keeps its first cost and is never reopened.

path_refresh_keeps_old_step.description: A path recomputed as the last step begins keeps the old step and drops the new path's first.

path_search_10000_failure.description: A search that reaches the destination after exactly 10000 expansions fails.

pending_order_limit.description: Each house's pending list holds at most 128 orders.

permadisguise_attack_cursor.description: A permanently disguised target passes the disguise rule.

placed_buildings_not_ever_built.description: A building put on the map by a place order does not raise its type's ever-built count.

placement_shroud_at_cursor.description: A person's placement click takes the shroud result from when the cursor entered the cell.

prone_attack_state_persists.description: A prone unit stays in the attack state and can fire again without a new firing sequence.

prone_get_up_repeated_destination.description: A prone unit asks for get-up only when its current non-empty destination is assigned again; off: every non-empty destination assignment asks.

prone_noncrawler_speedup.description: A prone unit whose type cannot crawl walks half as fast again.

queue_limit_counts_item_twice.description: The queue-time limit test counts the item in production twice.

queued_move_sleeps.description: Queued move and attack move are processed as sleep.

radar_first_building_decides.description: Only the first qualifying radar building decides whether the house has radar.

radar_pixel_cell_shift.description: The cell a radar pixel stands for is the one F3 gives, shifted from the point colour's cell.

ramp_shape_zero.description: A tile of the ramp range or of the smooth-ramp range whose slope shape is 0 becomes the tile just before the ramp range.

random_country_fixed_range.description: A random country is drawn from registration indices 0 … 9.

random_magnitude_overflow.description: The 'magnitude first' remainder keeps the negative sign of −2147483648.

random_start_asymmetric_range.description: A random start candidate's y range runs ten cells further than its x range; off: both from 11 to W + H − 10.

range_target_on_deck.description: A floor-bound target in a high-bridge cell is measured at deck height even below the bridge.

ranged_draw_half_span.description: A ranged draw whose bounds differ by exactly 2147483647 takes no value and returns the lower bound plus 2147483648, wrapped.

readiness_from_defended_damage.description: Readiness loss uses the amount after the defences and before the versus value, even when a later row stops the hit.

readiness_heal_over_max.description: A healing hit raises the ammunition of a damage-reduces-readiness type with no upper limit.

recover_keeps_pending.description: The whole-map re-cover and reveal leave pending re-cover marks in place.

recover_skips_allied_units.description: The whole-map re-cover takes in allied units' sights only at their next refresh.

redirected_shot_aim.description: An area-fire or spray shot is launched towards the firer's own target.

refinery_distance_wraps.description: The squared refinery distance is a signed 32-bit integer that wraps.

refund_at_current_price.description: A cancel refunds the item's price at the moment of the cancel less the balance owed.

refused_death_keeps_unit.description: A death request turned down because the die-1 or die-2 entry has no image frames leaves the unit in play with its current sequence; off: the resulting death kind counts as completed on the death tick. Not consulted in M3, which has no death handling (combat, M4).

refused_override_retargets.description: A refused override still replaces the target and destination.

region_join_height_asymmetry.description: Cells along cell x join one region across 2 or 3 height levels.

release_order_once.description: The automatic place order of a done unit is sent once.

repeat_direction_snap.description: A completed sequence's declared direction is snapped on every tick it stays current.

resource_timers_carry_over.description: Resource timers carry over between games of one session.

restricted_deck_overlay_indices.description: Restricted vehicles may use a deck only above overlays of registration indices 237 and 238.

resume_restarts_step.description: A resumed line waits a full step period before its next step.

role_one_past_end.description: A role naming the first missing tileset starts at the tile count.

rubble_overlay_by_index.description: Rubble is the overlay type at a fixed registration index.

sale_start_no_recheck.description: The start of a sale calls for no recheck of the offer.

search_one_object_per_cell.description: A search scores only the offered object of each visited cell.

secondary_wins_against_air.description: The secondary is chosen against an airborne target whenever it is anti-air.

secret_lab_pick_by_position.description: Each secret lab picks its entry by position with replacement, so labs can share a type.

set_facing_keeps_target.description: Setting a facing at once to its current interpolated value during a turn ends the turn at its target.

shared_control_centre_count.description: One count of active control centres per house serves every control-centre type.

shared_wave_slot.description: Sonic waves and magnetic-beam waves share one effect slot per firer.

short_game_first_three_base_units.description: Only the first three positions of the base-unit list count in the short-game test.

short_game_without_bases.description: A short game with the bases setting off is allowed (every house without a counted building fails at tick 1).

shot_distance_wrap.description: The shot-speed distance's sum of squares wraps in 32-bit arithmetic.

shroud_point_cell_wrap.description: A cell coordinate outside 0 … 511 is read as another cell by gap fields and the shroud point test.

sidebar_both_flags_rank.description:
An item with both the counts-as-aircraft and naval flags ranks 1 as
the new item and 2 as an item already in the tab; off: 1 in both.

sidebar_tie_newest_first.description:
A sidebar item tied with existing items on every key goes before
them (the newest first); off: after them.

sight_bonus_wrap.description: The height bonus of sight wraps into −128 … 127.

sight_centre_off_map.description: A sight whose centre is not a legal cell reveals nothing.

skirmish_drops_country_owned_objects.description: In skirmish, pre-placed objects owned by a country name or a player-at-position name vanish; off: they go to the first player of that country or to the player at that position.

skirmish_drops_map_crates.description: Crate overlays placed by a map never appear in skirmish or multiplayer games; off: they are kept.

slave_kick_delay_wraps.description: The slave miner's kick delay wraps when added to the tick number.

slow_walker_stall.description: A walker of speed 1 heading between east and south stalls.

speed_normalised_delays.description: Game speed reaches game state through speed-normalised delays and a chrono flash stepping in frozen cycles.

spread_attempts_count_failures.description: Failed spread attempts count and the cell returns to the front of the list.

spread_mark_kept_on_last_neighbour.description: A cell dropped from the spread list with one free neighbour can rejoin only through a rebuilding.

spread_offer_by_emptied_type.description: Neighbours of an emptied cell join the emptied cell's tiberium's spread list.

spread_ring_eleven.description: A scan radius of 11 uses the original's ring-11 list (one cell twice, some cells missing).

spread_stage_from_index.description: The stage a cell needs to spread depends on the tiberium's index.

spy_satellite_first_building_decides.description: Only the first qualifying spy-satellite building is looked at.

stale_fill_tiles.description: The fill uses the base tiles of the theater loaded before.

stale_offer_orderable.description: A type left in the offer after it stopped qualifying can be ordered until the next recheck.

stale_suspended_revert.description: Start-next and force leave the suspended behaviour and the put-aside target and destination in place, so a late revert can bring them back; off: an effective start-next or force empties them.

start_waypoint_gap.description: The start list skips undefined start waypoints and K stops at the first gap; off: position i is waypoint i whenever it is defined.

starting_infantry_share_centre.description: A starting infantry unit stands at its cell's centre position whatever infantry already stand there, with no draw; off: it takes a standing position by S-0208 claim 3, with that claim's draw.

stationary_friendly_exactly_three.description: Stationary friendly needs exactly three allied infantry without movement in progress.

stored_target_point.description: Arrival, pass-by, same-cell and in-flight line-of-fire rows use the point stored at placement.

substitution_centre_ground_level.description: Destination substitution judges heights around the ground of a bridge-cell destination.

substitution_distance_flat_destination.description: Destination substitution measures to the destination cell at world height 0.

superweapon_setting_tests_first_only.description: The superweapon setting's build bar tests only a building type's first superweapon.

table_direction.description: Directions follow the tabulated arctangent and the short facing scale; off: the exact angle.

table_root_distance.description: Distances use the table square root; off: the exact integer square root.

table_trig_negative_bias.description: The table sine and cosine of a negative angle can land two steps short.

thinning_hits_waypoint_only.description: The waypoint-thinning action takes every bale from the waypoint's own cell only.

top_position_counts_as_centre.description: A unit standing at the top position is recorded as taking the centre.

track_body_turn_stops_at_target.description: A turret-less track-class body turn that passes exactly through its target's direction stops there.

train_exclusion_search_only.description: The exclusion of the cells behind a train holds for the search only.

tread_default_water_only.description: The tread entry is used for no current sequence on water only, not beach.

turn_rate_negative_wrap.description: A negative turn-rate field acts through its remainder modulo 256.

turret_reaim_after_turn.description: A turret still turning at the end of the previous tick is not re-aimed by the target rows.

turret_snap_bound_wraps.description: A turreted building's turret snap bound reads the turn-rate field as a signed value modulo 256; off: the bound is 256 times the turn rate S-0206 gives for the field.

turret_spin_quantised.description: A spinning turret turns by the quantised steps of claim 11.

two_sound_cues.description: At most two sound cues per sequence entry.

unchecked_substitute.description: A substituted sequence kind is not checked for an empty frame count.

uncounted_sight.description: The original applies an uncounted sight at a few moments, never removed.

undemolishable_heal_is_damage.description: The minimum of 1 on an undemolishable building applies to every hit no row stops, so healing hits damage it.

unit_changes_no_recheck.description: Unit entries, departures, owner changes and removals below the limit call for no recheck.

unload_without_contact_stalls.description: A harvester whose refinery breaks off contact while it unloads, with nothing queued, stays in unload until an order gives it a behaviour.

unscored_vehicle_stays_counted.description: A vehicle of a not-scored type is counted on entering the map and never taken off.

unset_role_range.description: An unset role's range still counts tile numbers from its unset start.

unstartable_queue_head_stalls.description: A queued type that cannot start is dropped and the line starts nothing more.

update_order_removal_skip.description: Each counting removal during the turn pass costs one later object its turn, and an object that re-enters play takes a second turn.

upgrade_fields_carry_over.description: An absent upgrade name field of a map building entry keeps the type the same field named in an earlier entry; off: it means no upgrade.

upgrade_level_without_room.description: An upgrade is placed even when the target records nothing.

upgrade_prerequisite_last_building.description: An upgrade prerequisite examines only the most recently acquired eligible building.

uphill_arc_45.description: Arcing shots at a higher impact point are launched at 45 degrees.

vehicle_buildings_keep_nobody_alive.description: A building that counts as a vehicle keeps its house alive only when it is a refinery-list building.

vertical_speed_uncapped.description: A vertical projectile's speed grows by its acceleration without a cap.

voxel_turret_exact_aim.description: A building with a voxel turret must point exactly at its target.

walker_overshoot.description: A fast walker can step past its walking target and swing back.

walker_targets_allied_wall.description: A walker that meets an allied wall with no object listed takes the wall as its target.

wall_cell_over_same_ring_object.description: A wall candidate wins over a candidate object later in the same ring.

wall_exception_skips_ground.description: A cell meeting a wall exception passes without the ground conditions of claim 3 (d).

wall_hit_minus_one_is_absolute.description: A wall hit of exactly -1 is absolute.

yellow_state_at_half.description: The yellow damage state is reported at half the strength, whatever the yellow ratio.

zero_distance_arc.description: An arcing shot at a point exactly below the fire point uses F4's zero-distance rule.

zero_kill_value_caps.description: A kill value of 0 against an actual cost of 0 sets experience to the cap.

zero_load_period_stalls.description: A load period of 0 keeps the harvester loading for good after its first bale.

zero_score_rejected.description: A final threat score of exactly 0 rejects the candidate.

zero_speed_launch.description: A start speed of 0 launches at a horizontal speed of 100.

SequenceEntry.description: One sequence entry of an infantry type (S-0107 claim 1).

SimData.description: Every simulation field of the ruleset.

animations.description: Animation types by type name (their art sections, S-0109).

behaviours.description:
Behaviour properties by behaviour name (S-0215 Import mapping: our
names, snake case).

difficulty.description:
The difficulty rows by our name (`easy`, `normal`, `difficult`;
S-0302 Terms, glossary *difficulty skill block*).

land_types.description:
Land-type rows by land type (S-0211 claim 2). A missing row has the
start-up row.

superweapons.description: Superweapon types by type name (S-0407 and S-0412 Import mapping).

tiberiums.description:
Tiberiums by section name (S-0401 Import mapping); the registry
`tiberiums` gives their order (S-0004 claim 10).

SuperweaponType.description: A superweapon type (S-0407 and S-0412 Import mapping).

disableable_from_shell.description: `DisableableFromShell` (S-0412 claim 9 b, S-0407 claim 7); absent: no.

kind.description: `Type`, the kind word as written (S-0407 claim 12 j); absent: none.

image_frames.description:
The number of image frames *N* of the type's sprite (S-0401 claim
15, S-0112 Terms *frame count*), from its art; absent: not known,
and an animated ore mine never makes resource (a provisional rule:
the importer does not read terrain sprites yet).

is_animated.description: `IsAnimated`, the animated flag of an ore mine (S-0401 claim 15).

strength.description:
`Strength` (S-0302 claim 20), with the game-wide tree strength
already applied by the importer (S-0102 claim 23); absent: unset,
which a placed object starts with as health −1 (S-0009 claim 42).

TiberiumType.description:
A tiberium (S-0401 Import mapping), keyed by its section name; the
registry `tiberiums` gives the order.

growth_percentage.description:
`GrowthPercentage`, *g* (S-0401 F5), a single widened to double;
absent: the double nearest 0.1.

image_run.description:
The image run (*P*, *F*, *S*) that the image numbers given by every
rules layer leave (S-0112 claim 10, Constants), worked out by the
importer from the key's history (the value 2 keeps an earlier *S*);
absent: worked out from `image` alone, and no run when that is
absent too (S-0112 claim 12).

spread_percentage.description:
`SpreadPercentage`, *s* (S-0401 F6), a single widened to double;
absent: the double nearest 0.1.

value.description: `Value`, the value per bale *V* (S-0401 claims 2, 3); absent: 0.

UnitType.description: An infantry, vehicle or aircraft type's simulation fields.

combat.description: The combat fields shared with buildings (M4).

fire_frames.description:
Art fire frames: standing, prone, secondary, secondary-prone (S-0107
claim 11).

locomotion_class.description: The locomotion class as S-0211 claim 3 leaves it; absent: no class.

locomotor.description:
`Locomotor`, the locomotor its class identifier selects (S-0207
claim 14); absent: the teleporting locomotor.

owner.description:
`Owner`: the countries that own the type, as country keys (S-0009
claim 45; unknown names dropped by the importer, S-0004 claim 3).

sequences.description: Art sequence entries by our kind name (S-0107 claim 1).

speed.description: `Speed`, the speed field v (S-0207 claim 1, S-0208 F4).

thief.description: `Thief`, the money-thief flag (S-0309 claim 5, Import mapping).

voice_select.description:
`VoiceSelect`: the type's selection responses, in the listed order,
every entry kept (S-0214 Terms, F5).

versus.description: Modifier per armour class, per mille.

verses.description:
`Verses`: the eleven versus values in class-index order (S-0003
claim 13, S-0305), each written as the exact decimal of its double.

range.description: Range, a decimal with a unit.

reveal_on_fire.description: `RevealOnFire`, the reveal-on-fire flag (S-0409 claim 16); absent: no.

speed.description: `Speed`, the imported speed field v (S-0306 Import mapping).
